about: The quality bar (docs/quality.md, story quality-ratchet): one entry per metric with its kind, direction, tolerance and source, and one bar per target. The bars are the first assessment's values; a value worse than its bar beyond the tolerance is refused, an improvement is written into the bar in the same change (IGNITE_BLESS=1), and a bar made worse than main's needs a decision. known_differences lists differences of the differential runner accepted until a story fixes them; eval_cannot_run lists the units the evaluator cannot run, with the reason; eval_slow names the decision that keeps a unit over the evaluator's time limit out of merge runs.
areas: Semantics: one meaning across the three consumers
Front end: the checker refuses exactly the wrong programs
